intro: Five complementary domains for learning how visual–inertial systems behave. Dataset descriptions refer to the official releases, not to a claim that every stream or sequence is included in VIOBench.
contentType: Curated dataset reference cards; learning-focus text is editorial guidance.

datasets.name: EuRoC MAV
datasets.sensors: Stereo monochrome cameras and synchronized IMU
datasets.description: Machine-hall and motion-capture flights with camera–IMU calibration and motion ground truth.
datasets.learnFocus: Start with calibrated visual–inertial data and inspect how lighting and motion affect tracking.
datasets.referenceNote: Vicon provides pose ground truth in the motion-capture sequences; Leica supplies position and structure measurements. Read sequence-specific ground-truth details.

datasets.name: UZH-FPV
datasets.sensors: Camera and IMU streams; additional event-camera and FPV image data
datasets.description: Fast racing laps and free-form indoor and outdoor flights with large rotations and accelerations.
datasets.learnFocus: Explore the effect of rapid image motion and inertial excitation on visual–inertial estimation.
datasets.referenceNote: Sensor availability and ground-truth files vary by sequence release; use the official sequence documentation.

datasets.name: AQUALOC
datasets.sensors: Monocular monochrome camera, MEMS IMU, and pressure sensor
datasets.description: Near-seabed harbor and archaeological-site recordings from underwater vehicles.
datasets.learnFocus: Study visual tracking when texture and illumination are limited, and identify which sensors an estimator actually uses.
datasets.referenceNote: A pressure stream is part of the dataset; its availability does not imply that a VIO configuration uses it.

datasets.name: LaMAria
datasets.sensors: Two grayscale cameras and an IMU for SLAM; additional sensors in raw VRS recordings
datasets.description: Wearable recordings spanning controlled motion and long city-scale trajectories, with surveyed control points and dense pseudo ground truth.
datasets.learnFocus: Connect head motion, image conversion, sensor calibration, and the choice of evaluation reference.
datasets.referenceNote: Original VRS and converted ASL/ROS1 images use different camera models. Dense pseudo ground truth and surveyed sparse control points have different evaluation roles.

datasets.name: GrandTour
datasets.platform: ANYmal D with Boxi sensor payload
datasets.sensors: Cameras, IMUs, LiDAR, depth, proprioception, and GNSS
datasets.description: Quadruped recordings across indoor and outdoor environments, including varied terrain, illumination, and weather.
datasets.learnFocus: Explore calibration, synchronization, and sensor selection in a multimodal robot dataset.
datasets.referenceNote: The full dataset is multimodal. A camera–IMU experiment uses only a declared subset of the available streams; exact ground-truth availability is mission-specific.

sources.title: GrandTour Dataset — ETH Robotic Systems Lab
